page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words marked [?] are uncertain in the scan; the Hebrew vowel points and the Greek accents on the Hag. and Act. passages are hard to read. The Hebrew after "dicit" is probably Hab. 2:4 and the Hebrew after "textu" may be a form of כָּלָא. The "•" at the left margin and the "«" before "Hebræi" are marks, not text. "Dieu" is the catchword, not part of the text. Long s is given as plain s throughout.
